items.title: Mrs. Francis Oliver Interview, 1969-05-10
items.q: His name was Lamar. See, but he took the name because he wanted to be right along with us. My mother wanted it that way, though.

ctx.x: Well, I don't—you know, I put Francis M. Oliver all the time. And the M's can either be for Mimi or Mouton. That's what I thought it was for the Mouton. Yes, it is for the Mouton. Because I never have dropped my father's name. Yes.
How come that the—Gellarrow changed—he evidently took that name then. He took it—he named it—
His name was Lamar. See, but he took the name because he wanted to be right along with us. My mother wanted it that way, though. Mm-hmm.
